summary: Bladex, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its second quarter 2026 earnings. The filing discloses net profit of $66.5 million ($1.77 per share) for 2Q26 and $122.8 million ($3.08 per share) for 6M26, along with operational metrics such as net interest income, fees, credit portfolio size, and asset quality. The bank also highlights its AT1 issuance from September 2025. There is no transaction, restructuring, or special situation event; it is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms are present.
